Ceiling fan.note: Actual three-blade ceiling fan photographed nearly face-on from below. The ceiling and fixed housing remain in the frame, so this is a stationary reference photo, not a spinning cutout or measured geometry. A separate phase marker illustrates the listed angular velocity; the pictured fan's speed and direction are not established by the photo.
